heading.medium: Common Inquiries About Skin Care Practices

sentence.short: Get answers to your skin care questions.
sentence.medium: Find solutions to your most pressing skin care concerns.

accordion.title-medium: What is the best skin care routine?
accordion.paragraph-medium: A basic skin care routine usually includes cleansing, moisturizing, and applying sunscreen daily.

accordion.title-medium: How do I know my skin type?
accordion.paragraph-medium: Your skin type can be oily, dry, combination, or sensitive; consult a professional for guidance.
Yes, using the right products and maintaining a routine can significantly reduce acne breakouts.

accordion.title-medium: What products should I use for sun damage protection?
accordion.paragraph-medium: Look for broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher to effectively protect your skin.
Generally, it's best to moisturize twice daily, especially after cleansing your skin.
